items.question: Which federal authority is in charge of managing human resources for UAE federal ministries and federal authorities?
items.gold: The Federal Authority for Government Human Resources (FAHR).
items.fact: FAHR manages human resources for federal ministries and authorities

items.question: Under which federal decree law number and year is the Human Resources Law in the UAE federal government issued?
items.fact: Federal HR law is Federal Decree Law No. 49 of 2022
